name: Parked camper logout and rejoin
fixture: Use a disposable Purge save with an existing 80s truck. Park on level ground, leave the driver's seat occupied, and release the controls before logging out.
observe: Use gamebridge.ps1 energy entity=ID to record mobility.rigidbody.worldPosition, velocity, rotation and the driver seat before logout and on return. In dedicated Purge, an observer already near the parked truck should also watch it throughout the reconnect.

cases.action: Quit to menu from the driver's seat and rejoin the same running server.
Repeat with a bare truck on the same surface.
Quit to menu from the driver's seat and reload the same save.

expect: The same truck remains at the parking spot throughout the join and stays upright.
The truck shows no sudden upward motion or rollover before player input.
Enter and drive the truck normally after reconnecting.
